title: Release logical hosting accounts without provider provisioning
problem: The existing hosting DNS rollout record 20a92691-558e-4939-8b61-6d777375c765 covers provider/DNS/Certificate Manager work, not the customer provisioning handler and additive account migrations. These reviewed operations are not deployed.
expected_behavior: Release source 1dee65da7b68f12d147d11e3f02befae06416ef2 with exact manifest SHA256 66393dac73a71bc1619c1ecf8350ac902abc1e96acf827cd6dca48ab619e4d37 from docs/sandy-engineering/evaluations/hosting-logical-account-release-candidate.json. Target sandy-customer-provisioning-api v10, preserve verify_jwt=true and all unchanged deployed module bytes; add migrations 20261024010000 and 20261024010010. Keep registry exposure disabled. No gateway/provider/runtime deployment, no billable resources, DNS/traffic/IAM changes or customer impersonation. Source CI passed all eight checks. Execution requires an appropriately reviewed protected release path; registration is not approval or deployment.
change_purpose: Bounded logical-account release under PR238 and the authoritative hosting scope; separate from the existing DNS/provider rollout because that record does not name the account handler or these migrations.
feature_improvement: Allow a normally authenticated verified customer to create/get one logical hosting account with tenant-bound idempotency and atomic audit, without paid provisioning.
acceptance_criteria: Verify exact reviewed source, manifest and existing deployment preimage under protected release controls
Apply additive schema and inactive contracts with migration history and preserve JWT verification
Create/get sandy.chat logical account through its real verified customer session; verify idempotency and tenant isolation
Capture rollback artifacts and actual deployment receipts; do not claim live provider or DNS acceptance
regression_rules: Preserve existing customer data and all unchanged deployed modules
Keep shared gateway, provider and runtime services unchanged
Rollback function through protected controls; retain additive account/audit/receipt data
Never substitute management credentials or fabricated claims for a real customer session
Do not create or expand IAM, credentials, standing policy or paid infrastructure
